intro.title: Progressions
intro.text: Roman numerals name chords by scale step. In G major: I = G, IV = C, V = D, vi = E minor. I–IV–V–I is the classic cadence (bars 1–4).

intro.title: The pop progression
intro.text: I–V–vi–IV (bars 5–8) is in thousands of songs. Learn the shapes here and you can play it in any key.

intro.title: How the mic scores this
intro.text: Where both hands start notes together, Keyboard mode scores your right hand (the top note). Both hands get scored once chord detection lands. Taps mode scores every note.
